scope: Independent, locally authored player fixture served by the current debug build. This is implementation QA, not a runtime capture of another product. No customer project content is included.

provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

groups.name: Initial logical page, tree, splitter, search
Depth-first navigation and search input focus
Widget actions and native form controls
Linear page order and browser history
Fit width / fit page / exact scale / hotspots
Stable key overrides valid wrong numeric ID

limitations: No claim of complete compatibility with native advanced interactions, adaptive views, dynamic panels, variables or rich-text wrapping.
Only recorded actions and assertions are covered; runtime behavior of the reference program was not tested.
The local preview host was stopped after capture; the recorded URL is ephemeral.
